statement: Every project and repository here is mine: the idea, the design, the decisions and the direction always come from me, and I review everything that ships. What changes from project to project is how much AI was involved, in any aspect: code, docs, design, planning or assets. The levels below describe that, and each project's README discloses its level. When a project sits between two levels, I disclose the higher one.

levels.label: None
levels.description: No AI involved in any part of the project.

levels.label: Consulting
levels.description: AI answered questions or helped plan. Everything built is mine.

levels.label: Assisted
levels.description: AI produced some parts (code, docs or assets). I did the rest.

levels.label: Co-created
levels.description: AI produced a large share, under my direction and review.

levels.label: Generated
levels.description: I gave the orders and prompts. Fully generated, reviewed by me, not written by me.
